span.label: The PPC is small and its anatomical borders are weakly agreed on in mouse, so injection targeting could be imprecise.
span.note: what this limits: every result reported for mouse PPC, and every join on that label: THE PPC IS A RELATIVELY SMALL BRAIN REGION WITH A WEAK CONSENSUS ON ANATOMICAL BORDERS IN THE MOUSE BRAIN
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Few injections were available per structure in the atlas dataset, giving incomplete regional coverage.
span.note: what this limits: the regional coverage of the atlas: A RELATIVELY LIMITED NUMBER OF INJECTIONS FOR EACH STRUCTURE ... CAN RESULT IN INCOMPLETE COVERAGE OF THE BRAIN REGIONS, WHICH MAY DISPLAY A HIGH LEVEL OF INTRAREGIONAL VARIABILITY
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The quantified signal is axonal, not synaptic, so laminar projection patterns must be read cautiously.
span.note: what this limits: any synaptic reading of the projection patterns: THE DETECTED SIGNAL IS PRIMARILY BASED ON AXONAL STRUCTURE INSTEAD OF SYNAPTIC INPUTS PER SE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The LD and LP injections did not fill those nuclei, so the apparent mouse-rat thalamic difference is not yet established.
span.note: what this limits: the apparent mouse-rat thalamic difference: AS LD AND LP INJECTIONS ... DID NOT FILL THE ENTIRE LD OR LP, THE COMPLETE REGIONAL INJECTIONS OR ADDITIONAL NONOVERLAPPING SUBREGIONAL TARGETING ... ARE REQUIRED TO DEMONSTRATE A TRUE SPECIES DIFFERENCE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Two ways of delineating the same region are reported not to match.
span.note: what this limits: any boundary assigned to mouse PPC: even with functional retinotopic mapping using intrinsic optical imaging, voltage-sensitive dyes or Ca2+ responses, the boundaries of VISa and VISrl were not clearly defined or mismatched with the architectonic definition
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Injection quality varies by structure because selection falls back through three tiers.
span.note: what this limits: any comparison of projection strengths between structures here: injections occupying over 90% of the primary structure were preferred, with fallback to 75-90% and then 50-75% where none passed
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A printed result is withdrawn as an artefact on evidence the paper does not show.
span.note: what this limits: the CA3 projection signal reported here: the authors state it appears to have resulted from a false positive quantification from the path through the ventral internal capsule
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The threshold for showing a connection differs between structure classes.
span.note: what this limits: any connection matrix read from this paper: only connections above threshold are shown, and the threshold is not the same for cortical and thalamic structures
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: injections that fill the entire LD or LP, or non-overlapping subregional targeting - NOT achieved, and the paper says the comparison cannot be made without them
span.note: eliminates: an apparent mouse-versus-primate species difference in thalamic connectivity that is really a difference in where the tracer landed

span.label: The mouse posterior parietal cortex sends its heaviest cortical output to secondary motor cortex, primary visual cortex and the barrel field of primary somatosensory cortex.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: PPC output to the thalamus is concentrated in three associative nuclei, LP, PO and LD.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The heaviest inputs to the PPC come from ipsilateral secondary motor, auditory and visual cortex plus primary somatosensory cortex.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Hypothalamic output of the PPC is essentially confined to the zona incerta, a connection not previously reported.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: What separates PPC from neighbouring visual cortex is that it gets more multimodal spatial input and less primary visual input.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The strongest reciprocal cortical partners of PPC are MOs, SSp-bfd, VISal, VISam and VISpm.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The strongest reciprocal thalamic partners of PPC are LP, PO, LD and PF.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Neuromodulatory input to PPC is dominated by cholinergic fibres, with weaker serotonergic and histaminergic input.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The posterior thalamic nucleus projects topographically, its dorsomedial neurons reaching VISa and its lateral neurons reaching VISrl.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Compared with rats, mice have lighter LD and LP projections to PPC but clear ventrobasal (VPL, VPM) and LGd input that rats were not reported to have.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The single largest mouse-rat discrepancy in PPC output is the infralimbic area, strongly innervated in rat and only trace-labelled in mouse.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Top-down cortical inputs from ILA and ACAd and higher-order thalamic input from VAL and PO terminate mainly in layer 1 of PPC.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Overall the mouse PPC connectome closely resembles the rat's, with a minority of clear species differences.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
